title: Jamie Oliver’s cooking programme began in 2008; by 2024, his food education work had reached 115,000+ people
summary_full: Jamie Oliver's Ministry of Food, established in 2008, has made significant strides in promoting culinary skills across communities. By March 2024, it successfully engaged over 115,000 participants through school and community-based initiatives. The program not only focuses on delivering practical cooking techniques but also aims at fostering healthier dietary choices for families.
